caption: The taut head of a large bass drum is slapped, and the head visibly dips and rebounds several times, each time smaller.

sa.check: A large bass drum with its head in view.
The head dips and rebounds more than once.
Each dip and rebound is smaller than the one before.
The strike is a slap with a hand, not a stick or mallet.
The slap comes first and the dips follow.

pc.expect: The head is flat and still until the hand lands; the first dip happens at the slap and only then.
pc.fail: The head is already trembling before the hand arrives; or dips while the hand is well away; or the hand lands and the head stays flat; or the head starts dipping again after lying flat with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: The head dips inward under the slap first; the first dip is the deepest and each rebound smaller, until the head lies flat.
pc.fail: A later dip is deeper than the first; or the dips stay the same depth for the whole clip; or the head stops dead while bowed in or out; or the head bulges outward toward the hand before dipping in.

pc.expect: The head flexes as a stretched skin, dipping under the palm and springing back; the hoop and shell stay rigid.
pc.fail: The hand's print stays pressed into the head after the hand lifts; or the head sags loose like cloth; or the shell dents or wobbles like rubber; or the head splits.

pc.expect: The drum stays put on its stand or the floor; the shell, hoop and stand do not shift with the slap.
pc.fail: The drum rolls or slides at the slap; or the stand rocks and keeps rocking; or the hoop turns on the shell.

pc.expect: One drum with one head; the hand passes through nothing and the drum stays one object.
pc.fail: The hand passes through the head; or a second head or drum appears; or the drum vanishes or changes into another object; or the hoop separates from the shell.

pc.expect: The head's colour and any logo on it, the shell's finish and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The logo on the head changes or moves; or the shell changes colour; or the background changes.

note: Separate dips may not be resolvable in the frames; a shiver that starts at the slap and fades counts as the dips and rebounds for S3 and P2.
